stories.title: Fiscal Discipline or Constitutional Crisis? Trump Moves to Cancel $810 Million Congress Already Approved
stories.conservative_headline: Trump Claws Back $810M in Wasteful Spending on Refugee Programs as Vought Delivers on Budget Promises
stories.liberal_headline: Trump Seizes Congress's Power of the Purse, Canceling $810M in Approved Funds — Even Republicans Call It Illegal
stories.poll_question: Can a president cancel spending Congress already approved?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Presidents should be able to refuse spending on failed, low-priority programs.
stories.poll_option2_desc: The Constitution gives Congress the purse; this is lawless executive overreach.

stories.title: Public Service or Propaganda? Taxpayer-Funded Ads That Look an Awful Lot Like Campaign Spots
stories.conservative_headline: White House Uses PSAs to Tell Americans the Truth Media Won't — Democrats Melt Down Over Ads
stories.liberal_headline: Your Tax Dollars Are Now Funding Trump Campaign Commercials Weeks Before the Midterms
stories.poll_question: Are the government PSAs public information or campaign ads?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Administrations have always promoted their policies directly to the public.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Using federal money for campaign-style messaging before an election is corrupt.

stories.title: Border Held or Border Theater? DHS Tracks a New Honduran Caravan as Both Sides Claim Vindication
stories.conservative_headline: DHS Locks Down Border as New Caravan Marches North: '16 Months of Zero Releases'
stories.liberal_headline: DHS Hypes a Caravan Weeks Before Midterms as Crossings Sit at Half-Century Lows
stories.poll_question: Is the caravan a real threat or election-season messaging?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Any organized mass crossing attempt must be stopped at the border.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Crossings are at record lows; this is fear-mongering before an election.

stories.title: Peace Through Strength or Endless War? Trump Rejects Iran's Offer to Reopen the Strait of Hormuz
stories.conservative_headline: Trump Refuses to Reward Tehran: No Deal on Hormuz Until Iran Capitulates
stories.liberal_headline: Trump Walks Away From Iran Off-Ramp as War Enters Eighth Month and Americans Pay the Price
stories.poll_question: Should Trump have accepted Iran's Hormuz proposal?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Accepting Tehran's terms rewards aggression and invites future blackmail.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Reopening the strait would end the war's economic pain and save lives.

stories.title: Guardrails or Government Takeover? Trump Meets Anthropic's CEO as AI Regulation Fight Explodes
stories.conservative_headline: Trump Refuses to Let Bureaucrats and Blue-State Governors Strangle America's AI Lead Over China
stories.liberal_headline: AI Executives Warn of Catastrophe While Trump Sides With Industry and Blocks Any Real Rules
stories.poll_question: Does AI need federal regulation now?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Heavy regulation hands the AI race to China and kills innovation.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Even AI CEOs warn of catastrophic risk; guardrails can't wait.

stories.title: Judicial Restraint or Rigging the Map? Missouri's Trump-Backed Districts Head Back to the Supreme Court
stories.conservative_headline: Appeals Court Green-Lights Missouri's Legal Map as Activist Judges Try to Block Voters' Will
stories.liberal_headline: Missouri Republicans Defy Two Supreme Court Rejections in Third Attempt to Steal a Democratic Seat
stories.poll_question: Should Missouri's new map be used in November?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Legislatures draw maps; courts shouldn't override elected lawmakers.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Redrawing mid-decade to erase a seat is a naked power grab.

stories.title: Booming or Breaking? Friday's Jobs Report Could Show Hiring Collapse From 162K to 38K
stories.conservative_headline: Economy Re-Accelerating on Productivity and Capex as Trump Demands Fed Cut Rates
stories.liberal_headline: Hiring Forecast Craters to 38,000 as Trump's Economy Stalls Just Weeks Before Voters Decide
stories.poll_question: Is the U.S. economy strengthening or stalling?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Productivity and investment are surging; one soft month proves nothing.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Collapsing job creation and sticky 3% inflation show real trouble.

stories.title: Erasing History or Managing Archives? Fight Erupts Over Moving Japanese Incarceration Records Out of California
stories.conservative_headline: Democrats Manufacture Outrage Over Routine Federal Archive Consolidation
stories.liberal_headline: Trump Administration Moves to Ship Away Records of America's Darkest Civil Rights Chapters
stories.poll_question: Should the incarceration and exclusion records stay in California?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Archive relocation is routine administration, not an attack on history.
stories.poll_option2_desc: These records belong near the communities whose families lived that history.

stories.title: Draining the Swamp or Protecting the Portfolio? Congressional Stock Trading Becomes a Bipartisan Campaign Weapon
stories.conservative_headline: Outsider Candidates Run Against a Washington Class That Got Rich Trading on Inside Information
stories.liberal_headline: Both Parties Campaign on Banning Stock Trades — While GOP Leadership Keeps the Bill Buried
stories.poll_question: Should members of Congress be banned from trading stocks?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Lawmakers with inside access shouldn't be allowed to trade individual stocks.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Disclosure and prosecution work better than blanket bans on lawmakers.

stories.title: Overrun or Underfunded? National Parks Buckle Under Staffing Shortages as a Culture War Rewrites the Signs
stories.conservative_headline: Parks Finally Tell America's Story Straight After Years of Woke Revisionism on Federal Land
stories.liberal_headline: Gutted Staffing and Rewritten History: Inside the Administration's Takeover of America's Parks
stories.poll_question: What's the real crisis in America's national parks?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Parks should celebrate America, not lecture visitors about its sins.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Staffing cuts and political meddling are wrecking the parks people love.
